title: Workforce Services Associate Manager
description:
**Skill required:** 
 Workforce Dialer \- Workforce Management (WFM)
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Workforce Services Associate Manager
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 Any Graduation
   

  

**Years of Experience:** 
 12 to 15 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?**
* Workforce Services provides integrated forecasting, capacity planning, workforce optimization and analytics for back\-office and shared\-services operations. The offering connects demand, skills, staffing, productivity and financial plans to improve resource utilization, service delivery, cost efficiency and workforce readiness across portfolios.
* Lead the workforce planning cycle from demand intake and historical trend analysis through forecasting, capacity modelling, staffing plans, governance and performance reviews. Monitor forecast accuracy, backlog, productivity, utilization and hiring variance; run scenarios, identify capacity risks and coordinate mitigation with Operations, Finance, HR, Recruitment, Transition and Client teams.
* Expertise in forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling governance, workload modelling and workforce optimization for back\-office operations. Strong analytical, financial and business acumen, with advanced Excel and hands\-on Power BI, Power Query, Power Apps and Power Automate capability. Excellent stakeholder communication, business storytelling, problem solving and people leadership skills. What are we looking for?
* An experienced Workforce Management leader with 12 to15 years of overall experience, including at least 8 years in forecasting, capacity planning, workforce analytics or operations strategy and 3 to 5 years in people and stakeholder leadership. The candidate should be able to manage multiple portfolios, translate business demand into practical staffing strategies, influence senior stakeholders, build robust governance and deliver measurable improvements in accuracy, productivity, utilization and cost. A bachelors degree is required; global delivery or shared\-services experience is preferred. Roles and Responsibilities:
* Lead short\-, medium\- and long\-term forecasting and capacity planning across back\-office and shared\-services programs.
* Build demand forecasts using historical performance, business drivers, seasonality, growth assumptions and operational inputs.
* Convert demand into workload models, staffing plans, hiring forecasts and capacity strategies aligned with SLAs, budgets and delivery commitments.
* Run scenarios; identify capacity gaps, risks, assumptions and dependencies, and define mitigations with clear ownership.
* Balance demand and supply through hiring, cross\-skilling, redeployment, productivity improvement and automation opportunities.
* Govern utilization, occupancy, productivity, backlog, forecast accuracy, hiring variance and resource\-fulfilment timelines across portfolios.
* Support transition, ramp\-up, stabilization and ramp\-down planning, ensuring workforce readiness at each stage.
* Develop and maintain executive dashboards, reports and scorecards using advanced Excel, Power BI and related reporting tools.
* Use Power Query, Power Apps and Power Automate to simplify, standardize and automate workforce processes.
* Analyse trends, translate findings into actions and present capacity outlooks to senior stakeholders.
* Align workforce plans with financial targets; monitor cost\-to\-serve and identify FTE optimization, productivity and margin\-improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Operations, Finance, HR, Recruitment, Transition, Technology, Client Leadership and Delivery teams to resolve planning constraints.
* Lead workforce governance forums, drive timely decisions and promote adoption of standard planning practices across accounts and functions.
* Lead, coach and mentor workforce specialists, analysts and leads; set performance expectations and strengthen team capability.
* Foster accountability, innovation and continuous improvement while ensuring reporting accuracy and governance compliance.

title: Assistant Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 JobsMato specializes in comprehensive recruitment solutions that help businesses find and retain top talent. Acting as a strategic recruitment partner, JobsMato works closely with organizations to function as an extension of their HR teams. The focus is on delivering high\-quality candidates aligned with each company’s needs, culture, and long\-term goals. Team members at JobsMato contribute directly to building strong client relationships and shaping effective talent strategies. This environment offers opportunities to grow in client\-facing roles and develop expertise in recruitment services.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Assistant Relationship Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurgaon. This position supports relationship managers in maintaining and strengthening client partnerships, ensuring smooth communication and delivery of recruitment services. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include coordinating with clients to understand hiring needs, following up on recruitment processes, preparing reports and updates, and ensuring timely resolution of client queries. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams to align candidate sourcing with client requirements, scheduling meetings and interviews, and helping manage documentation and records related to client engagements. The Assistant Relationship Manager is expected to maintain a professional, service\-oriented approach and contribute to client satisfaction and retention.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong client relationship and account coordination skills, including stakeholder management and follow\-up capabilities.
* Candidates should possess communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present information clearly and build trust with clients and internal teams.
* Candidates should possess organizational and administrative skills, such as documentation management, basic reporting, and attention to detail.
* Candidates should possess basic understanding of recruitment or HR processes, with the ability to coordinate interview schedules and track hiring progress.
* Candidates should possess problem\-solving and service\-oriented skills, including the ability to handle client queries and support issue resolution.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in business, management, HR, or a related field, and prior experience in client\-facing or coordination roles are beneficial.
* Proficiency in common office software (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, email tools) and comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment is an advantage.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 AFCL Televentures Limited is one of North India’s largest distributors of Apple products, serving key regions including Delhi, Uttarakhand, and Eastern Uttar Pradesh. The company focuses on delivering high\-quality consumer technology solutions to a broad retail and channel network. As a growing organization, AFCL emphasizes operational excellence, strong partner relationships, and customer satisfaction. Team members join a fast\-paced environment where they can contribute to strategic growth and process improvement across the distribution business.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Senior Human Resources Manager is a full\-time on\-site role based in New Delhi. This role oversees end\-to\-end HR operations, including talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, employee relations, and compliance with labor laws and company policies. The Senior Human Resources Manager will design and implement HR strategies, policies, and frameworks that support workforce planning, employee engagement, and retention. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include managing HR team members, advising leadership on organizational development, handling disciplinary and grievance procedures, and ensuring accurate HR documentation and reporting. The role also involves coordinating training and development programs, leading HR projects and initiatives, and promoting an inclusive, ethical, and high\-performance workplace culture.

* Experience managing HR operations, including payroll coordination, benefits administration, HRIS usage, and compliance with local labor and statutory requirements.
* Skills in organizational development, change management, workforce planning, and succession planning to support business growth.
* Proficiency in communication, conflict resolution, negotiation, and stakeholder management when working with leadership, staff, and external partners.
* Ability to design and lead training, coaching, and employee engagement initiatives that strengthen culture and productivity.

* Demonstrated ability to work on\-site in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and use HR data and analytics to guide decision\-making.

title: SENIOR MANAGER – HUMAN RESOURCES  & PEOPLE OPERATIONS
description:
**Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| 4–6 Years Experience**




 We are looking for a sharp, ambitious and highly dependable 
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations** 
  to establish and run the core HR operating systems of our Delhi NCR headquarters.
 



 This is a broad, hands\-on management mandate covering 
 **recruitment, payroll management, employee lifecycle, HR systems, international personnel administration, work\-authorisation coordination, performance processes, HR compliance, employee records and management reporting** 
 .
 



 The person joining us will not simply inherit an existing HR desk. They will help build a disciplined and scalable People Operations function capable of supporting a growing Indian and international workforce.
   





 The Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations will be responsible for establishing and operating the 
 **Delhi HQ HR infrastructure** 
  and ensuring that employee administration is accurate, controlled, responsive and scalable.
 



 The role will include:
 


1. Establishing the core 
 **HR operating framework for the Delhi NCR headquarters** 
 , including HRIS, employee master data, personnel files, joining systems, attendance, leave, payroll controls, probation, performance\-cycle administration and separation processes.
2. Managing 
 **end\-to\-end payroll administration and payroll coordination** 
 , including monthly employee data, attendance and leave inputs, salary changes, approved deductions, reimbursements, variable\-pay inputs, new joiners, exits and payroll reconciliation.
3. Working with Finance, payroll vendors and management to ensure that payroll records reconcile with approved employment terms and employee master data.
4. Maintaining payroll calendars, change\-control records, salary/CTC documentation and payroll exception trackers.
5. Coordinating statutory and employee\-related payroll documentation with the appropriate Finance, Legal, payroll and professional advisers.
6. Managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple concurrent managerial, specialist, technical and administrative mandates.
7. Managing RPOs, recruitment agencies, LinkedIn, job portals, direct sourcing and referral channels.
8. Coordinating candidate assessment, interview scheduling, approvals, compensation discussions, offers and joining.
9. Managing BGV, references, pre\-employment documentation and controlled onboarding.
10. Creating and maintaining accurate employee records, organisation data, reporting relationships, designation/grade records and employment\-history documentation.
11. Managing attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, promotions, approved compensation changes, transfers and employee status changes.
12. Operationalising Board\- and management\-approved HR, workplace, travel, employee and administrative policies.
13. Maintaining policy acknowledgements, training evidence, compliance registers and HR audit documentation.
14. Supporting performance\-management administration, including 
 **30/60/90\-day reviews, probation reviews, confirmation documentation, performance records and management follow\-up** 
 .
15. Handling employee grievances, disciplinary documentation, difficult employee matters, resignations, handovers, separation processes and final\-clearance coordination.
16. Maintaining appropriate confidentiality and access controls for sensitive personnel and compensation data.
17. Coordinate 
 **international employee mobility** 
 , including visa/work\-authorisation, immigration, FRRO/FRO and renewal documentation through Legal/authorised advisers.
18. Maintain complete 
 **passport, visa, permit, registration and expiry controls** 
  for foreign personnel and international specialists.
19. Coordinate 
 **invitation letters, supporting documentation, relocation, accommodation and joining logistics** 
  for international employees.
20. Maintain an 
 **International Personnel \& Mobility Register** 
  covering status, expiries, pending actions and responsible owners.
21. Ensure required documentation and internal clearances are complete before international personnel commence regulated or approval\-dependent activities.
22. Support overseas deputation, travel and assignment documentation for Indian employees where required.
23. Establish and maintain the 
 **Delhi HQ HR operating system** 
 , including Employee Master, HRIS, recruitment pipeline, offers, BGV, joining, personnel files, attendance/leave and payroll controls.
24. Maintain 
 **compensation\-change, probation, confirmation, performance\-review, policy\-acknowledgement and training records** 
 .
25. Maintain 
 **grievance, disciplinary, separation, clearance, HR\-vendor and management\-MIS systems** 
 .
26. Own the 
 **HR\-side payroll process and reconciliation controls** 
  in coordination with Finance and authorised service providers.



  




 WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 
 Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:
 


* a functioning Delhi HQ HR operating system;
* complete employee master and controlled personnel files;
* recruitment dashboard covering all approved vacancies;
* functioning HRIS or controlled interim HR database;
* reliable attendance and leave administration;
* documented monthly payroll process and reconciliation controls;
* BGV and onboarding tracker;
* probation and confirmation calendar;
* approved policy implementation and acknowledgement records;
* management HR dashboard;
* international personnel / visa / work\-authorisation tracker where applicable;
* HR vendor and recruiter controls;
* defined employee joining, lifecycle and separation workflows.


 THE PERSON WE WANT
 
 We are looking for somebody who can 
 **build systems and then operate them** 
 .
 



 A strong candidate will be equally comfortable interviewing a senior candidate in the morning, resolving a payroll discrepancy before lunch, checking the documentation of an international employee in the afternoon and preparing a concise management dashboard before the day ends.
 



 That breadth is intentional.
 



 The role suits an HR professional who wants genuine ownership and institutional\-building responsibility — not somebody looking for a narrowly defined recruitment, HRBP or employee\-engagement position.
 


 Particularly valuable experience
 
 Candidates who have previously helped establish a 
 **new corporate office, regional headquarters, business unit, plant, international office or rapidly expanding operation** 
  will be particularly relevant.
 



 Exposure to any combination of the following will be valuable:
 



***HRIS implementation • Payroll management • Multi\-agency recruitment • International employees • Employment visas / mobility administration • BGV • Employee lifecycle • HR compliance • Performance administration • Office mobilisation • Regulated or industrial environments***




 This addition makes the position substantially stronger. It now reads as the 
 **person responsible for establishing the Delhi HQ People Operations infrastructure** 
 , rather than simply a Senior HR recruitment manager.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
Head of Human Resources
 



  





**Location:** 
 Head Office, Okhla, New Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 10\+ Years
 



**Industry Preference:** 
 Healthcare / Hospitals / Multi\-location Service Organizations
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Seniority:** 
 Head / Leadership Role
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Head of Human Resources** 
 to lead and take complete ownership of the HR function across Cancer Healer Center.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have
 **10\+ years of progressive HR experience** 
 , with proven expertise in managing the complete employee lifecycle, HR operations, recruitment, performance management, payroll coordination, compliance, employee relations, learning \& development, and organizational culture.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on leadership position** 
 requiring the individual to build strong HR systems, manage the HR team, support business leadership, and ensure consistent HR practices across a growing multi\-location organization.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Complete HR Leadership
 


* Take end\-to\-end ownership of the entire Human Resources function.
* Develop and execute the HR strategy aligned with organizational growth plans.
* Lead and manage the HR, Recruitment, Operations and L\&D teams.
* Establish HR policies, SOPs, governance frameworks and reporting mechanisms.
* Partner closely with senior management and business leadership.



 2\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
 


* Manage recruitment across corporate, clinical, operations, sales, call centre and support functions.
* Develop manpower planning and hiring strategies based on business requirements.
* Monitor recruitment TAT, cost\-per\-hire, offer\-to\-joining ratio and position closures.
* Build leadership and succession pipelines for critical positions.
* Strengthen employer branding and talent acquisition channels.



 3\. HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle
 


* Ensure seamless onboarding, documentation, confirmation, transfers, promotions and exits.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HRMS and personnel documentation.
* Standardize HR processes across all locations.
* Ensure timely issuance of offer letters, appointment letters, increment letters and other HR documentation.



 4\. Performance Management
 


* Design and manage KRAs, KPIs and performance appraisal systems.
* Drive monthly, quarterly and annual performance reviews.
* Work with department heads to identify performance gaps and improvement plans.
* Establish a performance\-driven and accountable organizational culture.



 5\. Payroll, Compensation \& Benefits
 


* Oversee attendance, leave management, payroll inputs and salary processing coordination.
* Develop competitive compensation structures, incentives and employee benefit programs.
* Manage annual increments, promotions and compensation benchmarking.
* Ensure payroll accuracy and timely closure.



 6\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
 


* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace concerns.
* Improve employee engagement, communication and retention.
* Conduct employee engagement initiatives and feedback mechanisms.
* Monitor attrition and develop department\-wise retention strategies.
* Build a professional, ethical and performance\-oriented workplace culture.



 7\. Compliance \& HR Governance
 


* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Oversee PF, ESIC, POSH, gratuity, statutory documentation and related HR compliance.
* Maintain HR audit readiness across locations.
* Manage disciplinary proceedings, warning letters, termination processes and employee documentation in coordination with management/legal teams.



 8\. Learning \& Development
 


* Identify organizational and departmental training requirements.
* Develop structured induction and training programs.
* Build leadership development programs for managers and regional teams.
* Track training effectiveness and employee capability development.



 9\. HR Analytics \& Management Reporting
 


* Establish a centralized HR dashboard covering:
* Headcount and manpower planning
* Open positions and recruitment TAT
* Attendance and absenteeism
* Attrition and retention
* Employee productivity
* Payroll and manpower cost
* Performance ratings
* Training and development
* Employee grievances and disciplinary cases
* Present regular HR MIS and actionable insights to management.



 Candidate Requirements
 


* **10\+ years of overall Human Resources experience** 
 , preferably with significant experience in a leadership role.
* Proven experience handling
 **end\-to\-end HR responsibilities independently** 
 .
* Experience managing HR across
 **multiple locations and a sizeable workforce** 
 will be strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of recruitment, HR operations, payroll, compliance, PMS, employee relations and L\&D.
* Experience managing and developing an HR team.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory HR requirements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to operate in a fast\-growing, high\-accountability environment.
* Strong command over HRMS, MIS, dashboards and HR analytics.



 Preferred Background
 



 Candidates with experience in
 **hospitals, healthcare organizations, diagnostics, pharmaceutical companies, multi\-location retail/service organizations or other large workforce\-driven businesses** 
 will be preferred.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 We need an HR leader who can move beyond administrative HR and build a
 **structured, accountable and scalable people function** 
 . The individual should be equally comfortable with strategy and execution, from leadership hiring and organization design to resolving employee issues and ensuring day\-to\-day HR operations run efficiently.
 


* **The Head of HR will be accountable for building the people infrastructure required to support the organization's next phase of growth.**

title: HR - Business Operation

title: Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations
description:
**Role: Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations** 




  





**Company:** 
 STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana
 



**Position Type:** 
 Full\-time · Remote, based in Delhi NCR
 



**Reports to:** 
 Director of India Operations, with direct work for the CEO (US)
 



**Manages:** 
 People \& Operations Specialist; the operations function as it grows
 



**Hours:** 
 India business hours with a fixed daily overlap into US morning hours (Arizona)
 



**Start:** 
 immediate
 



  





 STEPS Talent is an enterprise technology staffing company operating in the United States and India. We hire for the hardest roles in ERP, Cloud, Data and AI, Cybersecurity, and Engineering. Our India business runs its own client delivery alongside the work we do for clients in the US.
 



  





 We are looking for an operations leader to own HR and business operations for our India company, and the staffing back office behind our client delivery in both markets. You will set the processes, manage one direct report, and be accountable for compliance, payroll, invoicing and the monthly close being right and on time. You will have run this full cycle yourself, month after month, and you will know where it breaks.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  





**People operations** 



* First point of contact for employees on all HR matters, handled confidentially and documented properly.
* HR policy and process: handbook, leave, probation and confirmation, performance documentation, exits.
* Indian statutory compliance: Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance, Shops and Establishments, Professional Tax, Gratuity, POSH and the Maternity Benefit Act. You own the compliance calendar and manage the external firm that prepares and files.
* Onboarding and offboarding for employees and interns, the HRMS, attendance and the leave calendar.

* Work with a Global Leader – Join one of the world’s top logistics companies with a strong international presence and reputation.

* Attractive Compensation – Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives and benefits.
* Collaborative Work Culture – Be part of a supportive, ethical, and compliance\-driven team environment.
* Local Role, Global Impact – Influence regional business growth while working with global tools, systems, and best practices.


**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. title: Assistant Manager People and Culture
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring an Assistant Manager, People and Culture for our corporate office in New Delhi.
 



  





  





  





 We operate a portfolio of boutique and experiential hotels — wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, heritage properties — many of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros. The corporate office is small and senior; the People and Culture function is being built now, and this is its first operating role.
 



  





  





  





**The Role** 




  





  





  





 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.
 



  





 • Engagement execution and reporting — town halls, festivals, birthdays, milestones, offsites, internal communication; monthly people MIS (headcount, open positions, time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, attrition, leave liability, payroll cost).
 



  





  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





  





  





 • 3–6 years in HR operations, payroll and recruitment — hands\-on experience running a payroll cycle and screening candidates independently
 



  





 • MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent; a graduate with strong HR operations experience will also be considered; hotel management education is an advantage
 



  





 • Hospitality experience preferred; multi\-location or distributed\-workforce exposure is valued
 



  





 • Payroll command — confident with attendance inputs, deductions, settlements and statutory schedules
 



  





 • Strong Excel and systems skills; comfortable on an HRMS and with digital record\-keeping
 



  





 • Screening judgment — able to assess fit on a first call and write a screening note someone else can act on
 



  





 • Documentation discipline — methodical, complete, consistent; nothing filed late or half\-finished
 



  





 • Clear written and spoken English and Hindi
 



  





 • Absolute discretion with salary and personal data
 



  





  





  





**Measures of Success** 




  





  





  





 • Payroll processed and disbursed on the committed date every month, with nil correction entries
 



  





 • No duplicates, no unnamed records, no stale summaries — database verifiable at any time without notice
 



  





 • Applications screened and first rounds completed within agreed timelines; candidates never left waiting
 



  





 • Every employee file and statutory register complete and audit\-ready at all times
 



  





  





  





 Location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope covers the corporate office and all properties. Occasional travel for onboarding drives, audits and engagement events.
 



  





  





  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the role.
 



  





  





  





 Selection process: telephonic screening → in\-person interview at the New Delhi corporate office → reference checks → offer.
 



  





  





  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

title: HR Associate
description:
**About Arbolus**
 Arbolus is the next\-generation customer diligence platform, redefining how private equity investors and consultants access real, actionable and differentiated customer insight on SaaS and technology companies.
   

  

 At the core of our platform is the world's largest database of attributable B2B customer reviews, giving investment and origination teams direct access to unique customer sentiment and a true strategic advantage to run faster, more confident diligence on the world's leading software assets.
   

  

 Since 2018, we've redefined the traditional expert network model with a tech\-driven approach that delivers high\-impact insight at the speed of modern dealmaking. Arbolus stands out through its unique database of customer reviews accessible via the Arbolus Customer Review Library, Canopy, our market\-first automated Q\&A tool, and our unmatched standard of client service — because great technology should always be backed by great people.
   

  

 Headquartered in London, Arbolus is a venture\-backed scale\-up with 170\+ employees across four global hubs, including Barcelona, New York and Gurgaon. Following a $20M Series B, we are rapidly expanding our U.S. presence as we execute our mission: to digitize human knowledge and make it instantly accessible and actionable.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The People team sits right at the core of Arbolus and is responsible for attracting, supporting and retaining the talent that powers our business worldwide.
   

  

 As an Associate in the People team, you will work across the full employee life cycle — from recruitment and onboarding through to performance management and offboarding — partnering with hiring managers to bring great people into the business and supporting them throughout their time with us. You will also play a hands\-on role in building the culture of our Gurgaon hub, from engagement initiatives to the day\-to\-day moments that make Arbolus a place people want to stay.
   

  

 This is a broad, generalist role with real ownership from day one, and plenty of room to grow as we scale.
   

  

**What You'll Be In Charge Of**
* Managing employee life cycle activities including recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, training, performance management, and compensation and benefits administration
* Partnering with hiring managers to write job descriptions, run interviews and hire the right people for our teams
* Planning and running employee engagement activities — celebrations, team events, wellbeing initiatives and culture\-building moments across the Gurgaon office
* Owning the grievance redressal process, handling employee concerns with care and ensuring timely resolution
* Analysing HR metrics to spot trends and improvement areas across engagement, attrition and performance appraisals
* Collaborating with stakeholders in India and globally to implement People strategies that support business objectives


**About you**
 We're looking for curious and ambitious people who are eager to learn, take ownership and contribute to Arbolus' growth. You enjoy working with people, you're organised enough to keep several things moving at once, and you're comfortable handling sensitive conversations with discretion.
   

  

**Requirements To Succeed In This Role**
* 1–2 years of overall HR experience
* Hands\-on experience with recruitment and broader HR responsibilities
* Exposure to the entire employee life cycle (hire to retire)
* Proficiency using an ATS
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to handle confidential information discreetly


**Nice to have**
* Previous experience in a start\-up or fast\-paced environment
* Experience organising employee engagement or culture initiatives
* Intellectual curiosity and a genuine desire to learn


**What we offer**
* Annual performance\-based bonus on top of your base salary
* 25 days of paid time off per year, plus all local bank holidays
* Comprehensive health insurance and gym membership
* Top\-notch equipment to keep your work efficient and smooth
* Free coffee, tea, snacks and lunch to keep your energy up through the day
* Regular social activities run by our local Social Committees


*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*
*Arbolus is committed to providing reasonable adjustments for qualified individuals with disabilities, in our job application and/or interview process. If, due to a disability, you need assistance or adjustment in completing your application please email us at* 
*talent@arbolus.com* 
*. Please put "Reasonable Adjustment" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. Please note that this inbox is not monitored for application status update requests.*
*We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. All job applicants must be authorised to work for any employer in the country where the position is indicated to be based.*

 We're hiring a Product Manager to help shape the core product from the ground up. The role focuses on translating business priorities into people strategies, advising leaders on talent and organisational matters, and supporting business transformation, growth initiatives, and workforce effectiveness. The successful candidate will work closely with leadership teams to enhance organisational performance and leadership capability while fostering a high\-performing and agile workforce.

* Collaborate with Human Resources Centres of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and Learning and Development, to deliver integrated talent solutions.

* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influence decision\-making through business insight and human resources expertise.

**Physical Job Requirements**

 Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

title: Head - People Success
description:
**Head \- People Success** 




**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Bhopal (Remote today; office\-based once our India office opens)
 



**Experience:** 
 15\+ YOE in human resources, including proven global team building
 



**Reports to:** 
 President, India
 



**Manages:** 
 People Success function across India and the United States
 



  





**About Sutra.AI** 




 Sutra.AI is a complete 'Data to Value' AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose\-built for mid\-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent\-pending fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Head \- People Success is the single point of accountability for talent acquisition, org design, performance, total rewards, engagement, culture, people operations and statutory compliance across all geographies in which Sutra.AI operates.
 



 The role partners directly with the President (India), the founder and functional heads on structure, hiring sequence and workforce spend. It is expected to challenge those decisions with evidence, not to implement them unquestioned.
 



**Base Location should be Delhi NCR / Bhopal.** 




  





**What You'll Do** 




 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Employer Brand
 


* Build the hiring engine end to end: role scorecards, structured interview loops, calibration standards and interviewer training.
* Own sourcing strategy and channel economics across inbound, referral, outbound, agency and partner channels; know the cost per hire and quality per channel.
* Own how Sutra.AI is perceived by the candidates we most want to attract, including careers presence, candidate experience and offer\-stage conversion.
* Establish a house standard for job descriptions, levelling language and hiring collateral across all functions.
* Close the loop between scorecard and hire quality, and let that evidence reshape how future roles are scoped.



 2\. Global Team Building \& Employment Structure
 


* Design and run hiring, onboarding and people operations across India and the United States.
* Own contractor\-versus\-employee decisions, own\-entity versus EOR calls, and regional employment contract structures; defend each call commercially.
* Build compensation benchmarking that holds across every market we hire in.
* Establish onboarding that produces productive contributors, not oriented ones, within a defined window.



 3\. Org Design \& Workforce Planning
 


* Partner with leadership on structure, spans, layers and hiring sequence, anchored to the operating plan rather than to demand.
* Build and maintain a rolling headcount plan tied to revenue and runway.
* Resolve reporting\-line and title inconsistencies across the existing organisation and establish a single levelling taxonomy.
* Tell leadership when we are hiring the wrong role at the wrong time, and specify what to hire instead.



 4\. Performance, Career Frameworks \& Total Rewards
 


* Design career frameworks and competency ladders per function, defining what good looks like at each level.
* Build a performance cycle from first principles that managers and employees find useful, and that makes promotion decisions defensible.
* Own levelling, banding and the annual compensation cycle across both markets, including internal equity management.
* Own ESOP administration and the employee education that makes equity comprehensible.
* Build a recognition programme that rewards behaviour and outcomes rather than tenure.



 5\. Engagement, Retention \& Wellbeing
 


* Own team health as a measured number: eNPS, pulse surveys, skip\-levels and stay interviews.
* Act on what listening mechanisms surface and close the loop visibly.
* Keep regretted attrition low, and diagnose the true cause behind every exit.
* Make working at Sutra.AI feel connected for people who may never share an office.



 6\. Culture \& Internal Communication
 


* Build the rituals, communication rhythms and feedback loops that make two time zones operate as one company.
* Establish written and verbal communication norms appropriate to a distributed, senior team.
* Keep culture deliberate rather than accidental as headcount grows.



 7\. People Operations \& Compliance
 


* Own HRIS selection and implementation, policy, payroll coordination and the people data layer.
* Own statutory compliance in India (PF, ESI, POSH, gratuity, S\&E, labour codes) and equivalent obligations in the United States and any subsequent geography.
* Build documentation and audit readiness ahead of customer, investor and certification requirements. Our customers operate in healthcare, financial services, aviation and defence\-adjacent sectors and will audit our controls.
* Partner with Engineering and Platform on people\-side controls relevant to ISO 27001, SOC 2 and equivalent frameworks.



 8\. Leadership Coaching
 


* Act as a thought partner to the founders and functional heads on structure, talent and organisational decisions.
* Coach first\-time managers into competent ones.
* Have the hard conversations that nobody else in the company is positioned to have, including with leadership.



  





**Focus Areas (Outcomes)** 



* **Hiring:** 
 Predictable, forecastable hiring with a defensible quality bar.
* **Structure:** 
 A levelled, coherent organisation with clear reporting lines and no duplicated accountability.
* **Rewards:** 
 Compensation that is benchmarked, internally equitable and explainable by managers.
* **Retention:** 
 Measured team health, low regretted attrition and diagnosed causes.
* **Governance:** 
 Clean statutory compliance and audit\-ready people operations in every geography.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Must\-Have** 



* **Experience:** 
 15\+ years in human resources, including 5\+ years owning the function as Head of HR, VP People or CHRO.
* **Global Team Building:** 
 Demonstrated hiring and people operations across at least two countries; India and the United States preferred.
* **Compensation Architecture:** 
 Built levelling and compensation frameworks from scratch, not inherited and maintained them.
* **Compliance Depth:** 
 Fluent in Indian statutory and payroll obligations, with practical working knowledge of US employment requirements.
* **Environment:** 
 Direct experience in startups or fast\-growth technology environments; comfortable operating as the entire function before building a team.
* **Talent Market Knowledge:** 
 Has hired engineering, data and GTM talent under pressure and understands those markets specifically.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Proven credibility as a coach and challenger to founders and senior leaders.



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience scaling an organisation from approximately 50 to 300\+ people.
* ESOP design, administration and employee education experience.
* Experience establishing a US entity or EOR arrangement operated from India.
* Exposure to SaaS or AI technology landscapes.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2 or comparable certification from the people\-controls side.



  





**This role is NOT for you if** 



* You need an existing process to run rather than a blank page.
* You view people as downstream of business decisions rather than shaping them.
* You are uncomfortable disagreeing with founders in the room.
* You require permanently remote work. The base location requirement is firm.



  





**Core Competencies** 




 Technical \& Functional Competencies
 


* **Talent Acquisition Systems:** 
 Scorecard design, structured interviewing, calibration, funnel forecasting and channel economics.
* **Organisation Design:** 
 Structure, spans and layers, levelling taxonomy, decision rights and workforce planning against an operating plan.
* **Total Rewards:** 
 Multi\-market benchmarking, banding, internal equity, annual cycle design and equity administration.
* **Performance Systems:** 
 Competency frameworks, review philosophy, promotion governance and manager enablement.
* **People Analytics:** 
 Attrition, engagement and hiring data used diagnostically, not descriptively.
* **Employment Law \& Compliance:** 
 India statutory obligations, US employment requirements, cross\-border employment structures.

 Culture, ritual and communication design across time zones.



  





**Behavioural Competencies** 



* **Structural Thinking:** 
 Sees duplicated or absent accountability in a messy org and can articulate the fix.
* **Candour:** 
 Disagrees in the room rather than afterwards, with evidence, and commits fully once decided.
* **Data Fluency:** 
 Substantiates claims with cohort, manager and period\-level evidence.
* **Ownership:**

title: Compensation Benefits Manager
description:
**Description** 




 At Air India Express, our Compensation \& Benefits team drives reward strategies that enable business success and enhance employee experience. As trusted advisors, they manage compensation frameworks, benefits programs, market benchmarking, pay governance, and reward initiatives while partnering closely with business leaders and HR teams for complex business. Combining analytical excellence with a people\-centric approach, they help build a fair, competitive, and performance\-driven workplace.
 



  





**Role\-** 
 Compensation and Benefits Manager
 



**Designation –** 
 Senior Manager
 



**Reporting To\-** 
 Total Rewards Head
 



**Location\-** 
 Gurugram

 \- 5\-8 Yrs. in C\&B

**Role Purpose:** 




 Support as the Total Rewards advisor by providing expertise on compensation and benefits, enabling HR and business teams to drive consistent, performance\-linked, and compliant rewards decisions. Providing data\-driven recommendations to support fair, compliant, and business\-relevant reward decisions. Demonstrate strong business acumen to proactively identify reward policy needs and recommend new policies through detailed data analysis and organizational insights, while ensuring alignment with policies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities\-** 




**1\.Strategic Activities:** 




 • Support the delivery and execution of the Total Rewards strategy by ensuring compensation and benefits plans remain competitive, cost\-effective, and aligned with organizational objectives.

 • Partner with different COEs to align reward programs with performance outcomes and drive a culture of meritocracy
 



  





**2\.Total Rewards:** 




 • Implement rewards and recognition plans within the organization; support the development and rollout of programs where necessary
 



 • Lead the appraisal cycle and bonus payout process in alignment with group principles, while co\-developing guiding principles with the group organization
 



 • Prepare presentations and board notes for the NRC and Board, Implement best\-in\-class rewards strategy for all employee base
 



 • Plan and drive changes related to employee benefits and renewals, such as insurance and car lease programs
 



 • Coordinate with vendors / consultants to facilitate and promote contract renewal and performance management of vendors
 



 • Help in conducting periodic market / competitor benchmarking exercises to ensure pay structures and rewards remain competitive; liaise with external consultants, as and when required
 



 • Conduct ongoing research into emerging trends, issues and best practices and periodic audits to assess relevance and compliance of reward practices
 



 • Act as a Subject Matter Expert on all rewards related matters for the Head\- Total Rewards.
 



 • Oversee compensation and benefits for international employees and expatriates within the organization
 



 • Develop and implement policies, both independently and in alignment with Group.
 



  





**3\. HRIS \& Data Management:** 




 • Maintain and update statutory benefits\-related data in the HRIS system (including PF, gratuity, and leave policies).
 



 • Work with vendors and internal IT teams to ensure proper configuration and updates of C\&B modules.
 



  





**4\. Compliance \& Audit Readiness:**

 • Analyze trends and benchmark data to support C\&B planning and budgeting.

* Technical Skills: Proficiency in HRIS platforms, Excel, and data reporting tools. Knowledge: Strong understanding of Indian labour laws, statutory compliance, and employee benefit programs.



  





**Desirable Attributes** 



* Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail. High degree of integrity and confidentiality. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and drive change. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.



  





**Qualifications** 



* MBA in HR or related discipline from a Tier\-1 institute (IIMs, XLRI, TISS, MDI, etc.)

title: Learning Specialist IV
description:
**About The Role**
* Work alongside our Community Operations team, Regional Comm Ops and Vendor Management on implementation of strategic and on\-the\-ground BPO L\&D initiatives and provide L\&D support, governance and performance management to our BPO L\&D partners.
* This role requires strategic thinking and excellence in problem solving, process orientation, project management, stakeholder management, and an understanding of how to analyze, track and report the quality \& efficacy of our BPO training programs and its impact to performance.
* CommOps is all about process efficiency, and as a BPO Learning Operations Specialist, you would be ensuring that these teams of rockstars are able to continuously provide world class support to everyone involved in the Uber experience. This role is about building a solid foundation for our BPO Learning programs, scaling it beyond what is today, and pre\-empting what it will need to be.


**What the Candidate Will Do**
* BPO Governance \& Communication: Actively lead in BPO L\&D syncs is essential for keeping BPOs informed of Uber priorities and upcoming programs, while also gathering insights on challenges and requests to effectively plan and support them. Oversee adherence to Uber L\&D ways of working, ensuring compliance to L\&D processes (e.g. ILC process, Sandbox, Weaver, 0\-30 Insights Tracker, FG Error Reporting, FTC, Mass Enrollment, Deployment Trackers, STEP, TTP, LAT etc), and maintaining up\-to\-date BPO L\&D resources.
* Manage Training Deployment: Oversee and/or coordinate of training deployments working with internal \& external teams (e.g. Vendor Management, WFM, QA, BPO teams etc.) ensuring deployment readiness by coordinating of TTTs, readiness of training materials (ILC/OLC), availability of trainer resources (ILC), and monitoring/reporting of completion via regional Deployment Trackers, while efficiently tracking and managing tasks through tools like Jira and Sprint Trackers
* BPO Launches: Project manage and/or participate launches (e.g. process, product, LOB launches, migrations, site launches etc) ensuring trainer readiness, coordinating of TTT sessions, readiness of training materials (ILC/OLC), trainer resources, and monitoring/reporting of performance 30 days after go live.
* Learning Content Management (LCM): Kick\-off LCM sessions w/ BPO teams by working with BPOs to review materials/curriculum, provide insights and feedback/recommendations to support design team's curriculum revamp/revision efforts."
* Performance Management \& Reporting: Responsible for driving, monitoring and reporting training, nesting, and 0\-30 day performance, facilitating (? need a better term) RCA and TNA sessions with BPO L\&D teams and drive performance improvement initiatives. Publish and report on 0\-30 BPO performance during stakeholder performance reviews providing insights on highlights, lowlights, and actionable items
* BPO Trainer Efficacy: Supervise BPO Training Academy efforts, supporting new trainers and coordinating/conducting certifications and recertifications to uphold Uber training standards. Hold periodic BPO facilitator observations for BPO trainings and review LES results to understand BPO facilitator opportunities, and design initiaitives to improve learner experience.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A person who maintains the spark. You're at ease standing in front of a group and explaining the inner workings of support at Uber
* A Self Starter that stays ahead of trends. You're ready for the autonomy that comes with building a new process at Uber
* Who can model excellence. You're able to inspire, energize, excite, empower, and model what you expect your participants to do
* Analytical. You can make sense of complex data sets to find root causes for training/learning issues and can use this data to identify people who may need retraining or remediation
* A Team Player. You're a natural at collaborating across functions or regions to get the best possible outcome for your training
* Poised. You're cool and calm under pressure; you follow through on tasks and look for opportunities to step up to new challenges
* Process driven. You have superior organizational skills and look at the best way to iterate on things to make them more efficient
* Naturally curious and a life\-long learner. You love learning how things work and you're always looking for ways to make the learning experience better. You enjoy testing different support strategies and tracking the results
* Motivated. You understand the impact of a highly satisfied and excited crew of users, and you are insistent about nailing and addressing issues
* Problem Solver: Best to add problem solver, and orientation towards continuous improvement
* Skill and passion: Passionate about training, with skills and understanding of curriculum and learning program development and facilitation
* Positive influencer: A strong advocate of positivity and hard work, strong influencer, a strong people person
* Thorough and proven knowledge of service support: Have a strong hold and be a SME on service\-specific support


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience: 3\+ Minimum Years of Experience with Learning and Development (external/internal). BPO experience is preferred
* Communication Skills: Using communication skills and situational awareness to clearly deliver information to a variety of audiences. Exceptional spoken and written English comprehension and communication
* L\&D Thought Leadership: Possess depth of knowledge and experience in Learning and Development using this expertise to recommend strategic and operational solutions to drive performance.
* Project Management
* Problem Solving and Decision Making
* Leadership
* Performance Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Analytics \& Insights Generation: Adept in collating, summarising, and analysing performance data and insights, making inferences and recommendations to drive performance and process improvement.
* Office Tools Competency: Good command of office tools such as Word, Excel and especially PowerPoint (and its Google Suite equivalents) for use during Training Delivery and Administrative tasks.

 Business Acumen

 Executional Excellence
   

  

 Functional Expertise
   

  

 Problem\-Solving

 Why Syneos Health
   

  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
 Responsibilities:
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end HR processes related to onboarding, offboarding, promotions, transfers, employee lifecycle events, and benefits setup.
* Prepare, validate, and facilitate the issuance of HR letters and employment\-related documentation, including offer letters, promotion letters, transfer letters, experience letters, and other employee correspondence, ensuring accuracy and compliance.

* Support internal audits and ensure compliance with employment legislation, company policies, and data privacy requirements.
* Create, maintain, and update process documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to enhance operational efficiency within a tiered service delivery model.
* Collaborate closely with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Payroll, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, and other HR functions to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Handle sensitive and confidential employee information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.
* Participate in projects, process improvement initiatives, and system enhancements, providing operational insights and recommendations.
* Effectively manage workload, prioritize activities based on business needs and service level commitments, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.


 Requirements:
   

  

* Minimum 3 \- 5 years of experience
* Experience in exposure of HR operations \& knowledge of HR operations processes.
* Analytical \& customer service oriented
* Workday knowledge \- mandatory
* Ticketing tool experience \- mandatory
* Proficient in Microsoft Office
* English level \- advanced

 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com

Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

 The HR Specialist provides administrative and operational support across core HR processes, ensuring accurate execution of employee lifecycle activities. title: L&D Trainer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**L\&D Trainer**
 The L\&D team is responsible for facilitating learning experiences in a job\-specific area and for on\-the\-job capabilities needed for TPSP’s global footprint. We manage the activities involved in the preparation, delivery and assessment of training and development solutions for Expedia Group TPSP. The team collaborates with Instructional Designers, Operations and Quality Assurance representatives to improve performance. The ideal candidate will be a self\-starter with a passion for talent development, a high level of flexibility, commitment, and the ability to train and coach within a high paced customer centric contact centre environment.
   

  

 Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.
   

  

**Introduction to the Team**
 The Product Team creates high\-quality end\-to\-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our customer\-first mindset focuses on developing products that encourage loyalty and repeat business from our travelers and partners. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to achieve growth and results for our customers and company.
   

  

 TPSP provides the platform and services to handle the service requests from travellers across the multiple brands of Expedia Group, in all locations. This role will partner with the global team, supporting team members, interacting with internal customers (employees) of all levels and external vendors in delivering our products and services.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Facilitate training to support global TPSP initiatives for different Line of Businesses
* Manage the learning environment: in person and virtual learning and create a positive learning environment in which participants feel safe to try new skills
* Prepare for training delivery by reviewing materials and participant needs
* Facilitate training using various learning methods to meet the needs of learners and the curriculum. Encourage participation and builds learner motivation
* Deliver constructive feedback to encourage self\-discovery and continuous learning
* Ensure learning outcomes by checking for understanding and skill acquisition and report findings and make recommendations to aid decisions making
* Manage projects as assigned by the Learning Team leadership
* Establishes and maintains positive working relationships with agents, peers, management, corporate, and partners
* Report performance of training classes, conduct training needs analysis and plan interventions for performance improvement


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Training: Facilitating adult learning solutions in a contact centre environment preferably within the travel industry
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communications skills; ensures the intended message is communicated clearly and in ways that meet the learner’s needs
* Strong organization skills: The ability to develop plans and set priorities; manage multiple priorities at one time
* Problem solving: Analytical problem\-solving skills; linear and logical troubleshooting skills
* Business judgment: Ability to demonstrate good judgment and proactive problem\-solving methods
* Learning theory: Can apply principles of adult learning theory to learning experiences
* Trust Each Other: We are all Expedians. We are accountable to each other to deliver on our commitments, and we will trust our team members to help get it done
* Traveller Focus: Promote a strong disposition to Traveller advocacy. Convey to the trainees how to passionately meet or exceed traveller expectations
* Embodies Expedia Inc. values and beliefs and shares these both internally and externally
* 2 years \+ experience in contact centre
* Travel knowledge: Minimum 1 year experience in the travel industry
* Good knowledge of Data dashboards, LMS, MS\-Excel and PowerPoint
* Willing to work in rotational shifts and weekends as required by the business

 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation.
   

  

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

title: Specialist, Oracle HCM
description:
**Make your mark with Thiess** 





 Every day, all around the world, Thiess supports and celebrates our people. We recognise talent, reward transparency, champion diversity and embrace change.
 



 Join us and hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.
 








**The Opportunity** 





 As Oracle HCM Application Specialist within the People Systems team, you will support and enhance Thiess's HR systems and technology landscape, applying strong technical and functional expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud configuration, integrations, and data management to deliver reliable system solutions and process efficiencies that improve the employee and leader experience across the business globally.
 




**Reporting to the Manager, People Systems, you will provide timely, high\-quality technical support to the HR team and broader business, including the scoping, implementation, and optimisation of HR systems projects to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient outcomes.** 










**As the \[Position Title], you will:** 





**Operational BAU Support** 




 • Act as the first and second point of contact for Oracle HCM issues raised by the global workforce through the ticketing system.
   

 • Be the HR domain expert and HCM functional specialist for the implemented modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals,
 



**Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.** 




  

 • Support strategy and roadmap formulation for Oracle HCM and other HR systems, supporting the Manager, People Systems.
   

 • Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.
   

 • Provide ongoing L2/L3 functional and technical support for production issues, service requests, and change requests, ensuring SLA\-driven system stability.
   

 • Make system configuration changes, correct data, and troubleshoot issues across HCM modules.
   

 • Keep clear records of resolutions, configurations, and known issues.
   

 • Escalate complex issues to Oracle Support or implementation partners (CIMIC / Oracle / WIPRO) where needed.
 



**Projects** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of HCM rollout projects, from requirements and solution design through configuration, data migration, cutover, and hypercare support.
   

 • Support the rollout of Oracle HCM across different geographies, and Thiess businesses working with regional HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
   

 • Define integration requirements between Oracle HCM and other systems, and resolve integration issues.
   

 • Take part in fit\-gap analysis and recommend target\-state design and process improvements.
   

 • Present project updates, steering committee papers, and post\-implementation reviews to leadership.
 



**Enhancements** 




 • Identify opportunities to improve systems and processes based on user feedback and recurring trends.
   

 • Support the design, testing, and roll\-out of new features, functionality, and quarterly Oracle updates.
   

 • Drive continuous HCM optimisation and automation of operational tasks and reporting.
   

 • Build and maintain reports and dashboards using BI Publisher and OTBI for actionable HR insights.
   

 • Support change impact assessment and user communication or training for new enhancements.
   

 Commercial \& Stakeholder Relationships • Look for cost efficiencies where possible, without compromising safety.
   

 • Engage others by focusing on common ground and shared objectives.
   

 • Consult with stakeholders before making decisions.
 



**People \& Leadership** 




 • Work towards plans to achieve team and business goals.
   

 • Support others to deliver results and improvements.
   

 • Coordinate effectively across teams and manage issues, conflict, and problems as they arise.
   

 • Build collaborative relationships with global HR functions.
   

 Health, Safety \& Sustainability • Understand the critical risks in your area and reassess hazards if the work area changes.
   

 • Know and apply the standards and procedures relevant to your role. Stop the job if in doubt, fix the problem, or warn others of danger.
 








**About you** 





**Formal Education** 




 • Bachelor's and/ or master's degree in technology, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
   

 • Oracle HCM Cloud certification(s) advantageous.
 



**Work Experience** 




 • 3\+ years' experience working with Oracle HCM / Fusion.
   

 • In\-depth experience with Oracle HCM modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals, Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.
   

 • Experience supporting or delivering Oracle HCM Cloud implementation projects, ideally across multiple countries spread across diverse businesses.
 



**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong domain knowledge of HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance and Talent management processes is a must
   

 • Strong technical and functional knowledge of Oracle HCM Cloud, including configuration, integrations, and data management.
   

 • Confident troubleshooting skills, able to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently within a ticketing environment.
   

 • Understanding of system integrations (e.g., middleware, third\-party HR platforms) and data governance principles.
   

 • Able to translate business requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
   

 • Proficient in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel.
   

 • Well\-developed written and oral communication, with excellent attention to detail.
   

 • Comfortable working with stakeholders across Mining Operations, HR, Payroll, IT, Finance and business leadership in different regions and time zones.
   

 • Strong understanding of HR processes and associated workflows.
 




**What's on offer** 





 At Thiess, our people are the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive \- safely, confidently and with opportunities to grow.
 


* Competitive salary package.
* Ongoing training \& development opportunities.
* A strong safety\-first culture across all operations, built on care, respect and accountability.
* Range of corporate discounts including health insurance (Medibank), travel \& retail products.







**About Thiess** 

 Thiess works with clients in Australia, Asia and the Americas in the dynamic field of open\-cut and underground mining.The pioneering spirit of our founders \- the legendary Thiess brothers \- is our legacy and inspires our vision to harness the power of people and technology to drive sustainable change. At Thiess, you will have the opportunity to play a part in the global energy transition. We are growing our commodities portfolio to include metals and minerals critical to the energy transition and developing services to enable sustainable mining.We’re creating a culture of curiosity, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous learning \- supporting our people to contribute to Thiess’ success and continued growth in sustainable mining. We’ll support you in honing your skills and developing new ones, taking on challenges and growing through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment. We offer our people ongoing technical training and development opportunities so they can reach their full potential. We also invest in the workforce of the future, with a range of programs for people starting their careers. We recognise the value of an inclusive and diverse workplace through our vision of everyone matters always. We’re focused on creating an inclusive environment to enable our people to bring their best self to work because they feel safe, included and empowered.

 Thiess’ Capability Hubs are a key part of how we deliver work globally \- connecting skilled talent with business needs to provide high\-quality, efficient, and scalable services across functions and regions. The Capability Hubs enable access to global capability, supporting business growth while strengthening consistency, performance, and value delivery across Thiess. Our Capability Hubs operate as an integrated extension of the business, working in close partnership with Service Recipients to deliver outcomes that matter. With a strong focus on service discipline, governance, and continuous improvement, the Hubs play a critical role in how Thiess operates and evolves.
 **Make your mark \- Globally, People First**
 Our Capability Hubs offer the opportunity to make your mark as part of a global business, collaborating across diverse teams to connect global capability with local delivery. You will contribute to shared success while building valuable professional experience in a supportive and respectful environment where your contribution is rewarded, and your wellbeing is valued. This experience is underpinned by four key pillars \- Global Connection, Meaningful Contribution, Career Opportunities, and a Values\-led Culture \- which define what it means to work within our Capability Hubs. You will work globally with diverse teams, broadening your perspective and deepening your expertise, while contributing to meaningful outcomes that deliver value to the business. You will also build practical experience and capability to support your ongoing career growth, within a values\-led culture where people are respected, supported, and recognised for their contribution.

title: Rooms Trainer

****Marketing****

****Personnel:****

* Supports Departmental Trainers through ongoing feedback and assistance at monthly meetings.

* Ensures that Front Office and Housekeeping colleagues have a complete understanding of and adhere to employee rules and regulations.
* Ensures that Front Office and Housekeeping colleagues follow all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to fire and hazard safety, and security.

* Ensure the smooth utilization and updation of the School of Hospitality task breakdowns, handouts and presentations.
* Ensures high standards of personal presentation and grooming.
* Able to multi\-task and carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.
